title: Tongyi Qwen Launches Qwen-Image-3.0-Pro: World's First in China's Text-to-Image Arena, 10px-Level Text Rendering Starting at 4 Cents per Image
excerpt: Alibaba Qwen has pushed the image model to a new level - Qwen-Image-3.0-Pro and Standard are now available on Qwen Cloud. In the text-to-image ranking of Arena,
content_html:
Alibaba Qwen has pushed the image model to a new level - Qwen-Image-3.0-Pro and Standard are now available on Qwen Cloud. In the text-to-image ranking of Arena, it ranks first among Chinese models and second among mainstream models. It is supported by ultra-long 4.5k-token prompts, pixel-level fine text rendering, and coverage of 12 languages.

The pricing is also very low: Pro version starts at $0.04 per image, and Standard version only costs $0.03. The most notable change is the architectural approach - generation and editing have been integrated into a single model, eliminating the need to call different models for image creation and modification. This means that high-barrier tasks such as multilingual long text layout have been significantly simplified, and the cost per call has also decreased noticeably, making it affordable and manageable for small teams. The production workflow for text-to-image has been quietly compressed.
